reconcile.note: The Geneva Bible's annotators read John 6 as spiritual eating by faith, distinct from literal fleshly eating, so it never invokes the Levitical blood ban.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible sets the perpetual Levitical and Deuteronomic blood-eating ban against John 6's command to drink Christ's blood as a direct contradiction.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells, The Skeptic's Annotated Bible (2013).

sides.snippet: But flesh with the life of it, the blood of it, you shall not eat.
sides.verseText: But flesh with the life of it, the blood of it, you shall not eat.

sides.snippet: unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don't have life in yourselves.
sides.verseText: Jesus therefore said to them, \"Most assuredly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don't have life in yourselves.
